read.thesis: Record $12.5B backlog and 20% organic bookings signal strong demand, but price realisation cut to ~1 point and leverage lowered to low 20s on supply-chain and inflation headwinds.

capex.quote: We now expect CapEx of approximately 2% of revenue in 2026, which will further bolster our strong free cash flow and balance sheet position.
capex.peers_comment: Management noted supply partners for fans, coils and heat exchangers are expanding capacity under strain; no explicit peer capacity commentary.

triggers.label: Price realisation cut 1.5 → ~1 point
triggers.quote: updating our full year price realization expectation from 1.5 points to approximately 1 point

triggers.label: Organic leverage cut 25%+ → low 20s
triggers.quote: We now expect organic leverage to land in the low 20s, an adjustment from our prior expectation at 25%+

triggers.label: Organic bookings +20%, backlog $12.5B
triggers.quote: Enterprise organic bookings grew 20%, fueled by robust growth across all segments.

triggers.label: Cancoil acquisition secures coil supply
triggers.quote: A prime example is our recent acquisition of Cancoil, one of our key suppliers, which strengthens our supply chain

triggers.label: Backlog for 2027+ over $8B
triggers.quote: of the $12.5 billion of backlog at the end of September, over $8 billion would be for 2027 and beyond.
triggers.highlight: over $8 billion would be for 2027 and beyond
